slides.headline: One prompt, full software plan
slides.say: In under a minute, I'll show you a GitHub project that lets you turn a one-line idea into a full software plan with AI teammates.

slides.headline: One sentence becomes a software plan
slides.body: Give it one line, get user stories, specs, APIs, and docs
slides.say: You type one sentence and it returns user stories, specs, APIs and documents.

slides.headline: 70,978 GitHub stars
slides.body: MIT licence · Written in Python · Since June 2023
slides.say: It has over 70 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the MIT licence.

slides.headline: Needs Python, Node and command line
slides.body: Setup requires Python 3.9 to 3.11, Node, pnpm and comfort with the terminal
slides.say: You will need Python 3.9 to 3.11, Node, pnpm and comfort with the command line.

slides.headline: Save · Share · Follow
slides.say: That was Day 20 of 100. Save this, send it to a friend, and follow, or you might not see us again. The full list is in my bio.
